findings.current: “Shut your mouth! How dare you speak that way right outside the imperial palace… What kind of disgraceful nonsense is this?”
findings.defect: Omits the accusation that the scholar is speaking this way in the Emperor’s presence, reducing the force of the rebuke to a complaint about location.
findings.rationale: 어느 안전이라고 invokes the ruler’s presence; 황궁 앞에서 separately names the location.
findings.replacement: “Shut your mouth! How dare you say that in His Majesty’s presence… Right outside the imperial palace, of all places!”
findings.source: 닥치시오! 감히 어느 안전이라고…… 황궁 앞에서 이 무슨 망발이오!

findings.defect: Romanizing the drawn-out food name prevents an English reader from recognizing what the giant shouts, obscuring the joke that the crowd and guards hear him call for a dish.
findings.rationale: The shout is an elongated 오향장육, rendered elsewhere in this draft as “five-spice pork.”

findings.current: “Hey, you lapdog clinging to power! Which academy are you from?”
findings.rationale: 개새끼야 is a strong direct insult, alongside the accusation that the addressee lives by attaching himself to power.
findings.replacement: “You bootlicking son of a bitch! Which academy are you from?”
findings.source: “야 이 권력에 빌붙어 먹는 개새끼야! 너 어디 서원 출신이야!”

findings.current: People stared in stunned disbelief at the giant—someone they’d never seen before, and might never see again.
findings.defect: Changes an assertion that they would never see a giant like this again into uncertainty about seeing this particular man again.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes the unprecedented and unrepeatable sight of a giant of his kind.
findings.replacement: People stared in stunned disbelief at a giant unlike any they had seen before—or would ever see again.
findings.source: 사람들은 지금껏 본 적 없고, 앞으로도 볼 수 없을 거인의 모습에 경악을 금치 못했다.

findings.current: “Not a chance. Hand over your identity tag before anyone gets hurt.”
findings.defect: Softens the guard’s threat from bloodshed to someone getting hurt.
findings.rationale: 피를 보기 전에 explicitly raises the prospect of seeing blood.
findings.replacement: “Not a chance. Hand over your identity tag before blood is spilled.”
findings.source: “어림도 없지. 피를 보기 전에 당장 호패부터 내놓아라.”

findings.current:
“We’re the acrobatic troupe performing at the banquet. That’s our official letter of introduction.”

“An acrobatic troupe?”
findings.defect: Narrows a circus troupe to an acrobatic troupe.
findings.rationale: 마희단 denotes a circus troupe, not specifically an acrobatic act.
findings.replacement:
“We’re the circus troupe performing at the banquet. That’s our official letter of introduction.”

“A circus troupe?”
findings.source:
“우린 이번 연회에서 공연하게 된 마희단(馬戲團)이오. 그건 정식 소개장이고.”

“마희단?”

summary: The draft largely follows the scene, but it loses a key hierarchy cue and obscures the food-shout joke.
